PLAN 03 | SHOTS 06-08 | THE ROOM IS BREACHED
Create a 15-second Seedance 2.5 cinematic sequence, horizontal 16:9. Exactly 3 shots with the local timing below. Preserve the assigned identities, masks, wardrobe, animal design and location geometry. Performance is expressed through posture, hands, breathing and weight. Render at natural speed with tactile analog texture.

CHAR_SHAHRNAZ = {{CHAR_SHAHRNAZ}}

ANIMAL REFERENCES

LOCATION REFERENCES
LOC_PRIVATE_ROOM = {{LOC_PRIVATE_ROOM}}
PROP REFERENCES
PROP_INSTRUMENT = {{PROP_INSTRUMENT}}
PROP_INSTRUMENT_BROKEN = {{PROP_INSTRUMENT_BROKEN}}
START STATE AND BLOCKING
STATE_BREACH. Start with the same closed door, sisters seated, cat beside Shahrnaz and musician playing visually. A enters first, B second, C third. Exactly six adults and one cat occupy the room after entry. The intact and broken instrument references are two states of ONE object.

SHOT 06 | 00:00-00:04 | THE DOOR GIVES
28mm from inside the room, shoulder-height facing the entrance. A forces the door inward and enters with B and C. The camera recoils half a step. At frame-left Shahrnaz lifts the cat with both hands; at frame-right Arnavaz rises toward B. Keep their positions legible.
SHOT 07 | 00:04-00:09 | THE MUSICIAN DISPLACED
Cut to a 35mm oblique medium shot beside the musician. C shoves the musician’s shoulder against the wall and takes the instrument. The musician slides into a seated position and reaches after it. A and B continue toward the sisters in the background.
SHOT 08 | 00:09-00:15 | ONE BREAK
Cut to 50mm at instrument height. C drives its neck-to-body joint once against the existing stone doorway edge, producing the referenced fracture. Hold the single instrument body and attached loose strings clearly through the impact. C lets it fall beside the seated musician. End on the musician’s hand stopping short of the broken wood.
LIGHT AND IMAGE
The same warm room light continues. Opening the existing doorway admits a narrow colder corridor spill. Handheld exposure stays natural as bodies interrupt the light.
SOUND
Door impact, hurried boots, a chair scrape, one sharp wooden fracture, loose-string rattle, startled breath. The instrument produces mechanical contact rather than melody.
END STATE AND EDIT
Shahrnaz stands holding the cat against her chest. Arnavaz stands between her and B. A is beside Shahrnaz; C stands by the broken instrument. The musician remains alive, seated against the wall.
Keep all character designs and prop ownership consistent across cuts. Use the camera paths stated for each shot and retain readable spatial relationships. Primitive ritual fashion cinema, analog realism. NO MUSIC, NO DIALOGUE.
